tasks.title: Feasibility: mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-NVFP4 (1T total / 52B active MoE) on the WOPR fleet
tasks.notes: Study, not a boot. Measured from the Hub API 2026-10-29: 610.03 GB of weights (index total_size 610030457408; 32 x ~20 GB consolidated shards, 44 files), ungated/public, Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License (modified MIT, commercial use allowed, MaaS resale needs a separate license). Shape from params.json: 72 layers, dim 6144, MoE hidden_dim 24576, 64 heads / 64 kv heads with MLA (kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope 64, qk_nope 64, v_head_dim 128), DeepSeek-style DSA sparse attention (topk 2048, 32 heads), kv_sharing across layers, 1M context (yarn factor 2048), an embedded DSpark speculative draft head, and multimodal text+image input. ARITHMETIC THAT DECIDES IT: a node is 128 GB unified, so TP=4 puts 152.5 GB of weights on each rank before any KV, activation or CUDA-graph reservation - infeasible with no room to argue; TP=6 across ALL SIX nodes is the only shape that could carry the weights (101.7 GB/rank, ~26 GB/rank left for KV, activations and CUDA graphs) - and 64 heads do not divide by 6, so even that needs an engine-side answer first; TP=8 exceeds the fleet. Note the displacement cost of any TP=6 attempt: it takes every node including the four running the production serve, so it is a declared full-fleet window with production stopped, not a background job. node_cost is blank on purpose: this row is a STUDY with no node time. Deliverable: a short verdict with the three candidate paths and their costs - (a) further quantization to ~2.5-3 bpw to reach ~4 ranks (checkpoint conversion project, needs a bits-per-weight target derived from the 128 GB budget minus KV), (b) a rented 8-rank box where the published NVFP4 checkpoint fits as-is, (c) park it. Also record what the DSpark draft head and DSA would need from SGLang/vLLM versions, since a mismatch is a second, independent blocker.
